title: FIELD/FIELDLIST raw companion adapter capture bounds
mode: Local implementation slice with generated fast tests
scope: Bound adapter-owned raw DXF callback copies for FIELD and FIELDLIST.
Bind accepted raw callback accounting to the existing per-import field-carrier receipt.
Keep typed field semantics, reference closure, serializer support, and native acceptance separate.

limits.lifetime: dx_data container lifetime; per-import receipt reset does not clear aggregate counters or sticky failure

behavior: FIELD and FIELDLIST raw callbacks share record, group, and logical-byte budgets.
The current import receipt records successful callback count and group/byte observations; stale generation, resource limit, or allocation failure prevents receipt success.
Stable receipt callback count is cross-checked against raw record ranges; mutable group payloads remain subject to existing semantic validation.
Export refuses incomplete or over-budget capture before publishing output.

diffCheck.command: git diff --check -- DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md dwg2dxf/dx_data.h dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp tests/CMakeLists.txt

assessment.planEffect: Records the bounded FIELD/FIELDLIST raw companion slice and its focused tests. Remaining direct raw OBJECTS stores still require audit against their existing import and writer gates.
